objects.description: The following analytic detects the execution of `winrs.exe` with command-line arguments used to start a process on a remote endpoint. It leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on process names and command-line executions mapped to the `Processes` node of the `Endpoint` data model.
